So there are currently three sites converting Capability:
- SQLite: enum name (uppercase)
- REST projection: name().toLowerCase()
- REST parse: valueOf(upper)

If I introduce `wireName()` = lowercase and use it in both REST directions, SQLite stays on enum names — a second vocabulary for storage. To truly have "单一词表" across the codebase, storage should also use wire names... but changing the persisted representation affects existing DB rows (migrations, compat). To avoid changing acceptance for uppercase payloads that used to work (valueOf(upper) accepted "TEXT" and "text"), making fromWire case-insensitive preserves existing tolerance while keeping one canonical vocabulary.
